audit.whatIsWrong: The chart marks level 1 Skill where whys[0] says 'you can't trade back', level 3 Kennen where whys[2] says 'even at best', levels 4-5 Skill where whys[3] calls them 'your weakest window', level 6 Skill where whys[4] calls it 'your guaranteed gap-close', and first item Kennen where whys[5] says 'a genuine coin-flip'.
audit.why: The true shape is a poke lane Kennen owns with one Ambessa stage at 6, when a 1250-unit suppress beats a champion whose entire defence is spacing.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Kennen / Kennen / Skill / Kennen / Ambessa / Skill / Kennen in both layers — Kennen 4, Skill 2, Ambessa 1, which fits 46.88% and matches every why on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kennen's ultimate is discussed four times without its cooldown, and Ambessa's level 6 is credited to an 'R-passive armor-pen burst' that is in Riot's text for none of her abilities.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120 seconds at every rank — ten seconds shorter than Ambessa's Public Execution at rank 1. That reverses the usual assumption that the melee champion holds the bigger ultimate advantage: he gets his back first, every cycle, for the whole game. It is the single most decision-relevant number in the matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: 120s flat stated in mid, late, spikes[1].text, phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns, explicitly against Ambessa's 130. Penetration claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never explains how Kennen's stun works. It refers to 'his R stun' and to a 'W mark' that 'lets him kite the dash for free'. Riot's passive: 'Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.' The stun is Mark of the Storm at three stacks — it is not on his ultimate, it is not on W, and it is countable.
audit.why: This is the whole matchup and it converts a mystery into arithmetic. Thundering Shuriken applies one Mark; Electrical Surge applies one passively every few attacks and another on activation, but only to targets who are ALREADY marked; Lightning Rush applies one just by passing through you; and Slicing Maelstrom strikes repeatedly. So the correct behaviour is to read your own debuff count: at zero marks you can commit a full chain, at two marks the next thing that touches you stuns you, and W's active is only a threat once he has already stuck a mark on you. The page's version — avoid committing 'while his W mark is live' — is both wrong about which ability matters and unusable as a rule.
audit.corrected: The three-mark rule stated in early, whys[5], whys[6], wants.you[0], wants.foe[1], spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1]. Lightning Rush corrected to a form that passes through units rather than a dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading is keyed to 'his W mark' with no cooldown given for anything.
audit.why: Thundering Shuriken is 7 seconds at rank 1 falling to 4 — it is the poke you are actually losing to, and by the time your cooldowns are longest his is nearly halved. Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s. Electrical Surge is 13 down to 6. None of these were on the page.
audit.corrected: Real numbers in whys[1], whys[3], mid, spikes[0].text and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] says 'Buy Plated Steelcaps early to blunt his auto-weave poke'. The full layer's own TL;DR says 'build MR'. Kennen is an AP champion and Electrical Surge is on-hit magic damage.
audit.why: Armour is the wrong resistance against every source of damage he has. Buying Steelcaps into a Kennen leaves you paying gold to reduce a damage type he does not deal, which is exactly the failure mode the on-hit interaction note warns about — his damage scales with attack speed and lands as magic, so an armour reading of the trade is wrong twice over.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to Mercury's Treads and magic resist, with the reason stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid tells the player to 'blink in only when his ult is down or after you Cleanse/QSS the stun'.
audit.why: Whether Kennen's stun is cleansable is exactly the class of fact the kit files record as unknown — needsResearch.cleansable is null on both champions, and the brief is explicit that empty means UNKNOWN rather than confirmation. Advising a player to buy a Quicksilver Sash on an unverified premise is a real cost.
audit.corrected: Replaced with a verified instruction: commit with a clean mark count or with Slicing Maelstrom already spent. The cleanse question is recorded in unverified rather than asserted either way.

edits.before: Kennen owns the opening levels — his Q bolt and W-marked autos out-range every tool you have, and you're an energy-gated melee with only Cunning Sweep until you pick up Lacerate at 3. Don't walk into a Q just to throw your own cone; last-hit at the back of the wave and eat the chip. The instant he steps into melee range for a minion or burns his W mark is your only opening: dash Lacerate's slow onto him and land one stack-empowered auto before backing out. Never commit your full E-into-Q chain while his W mark is live — that proc is what lets him kite the dash for free.
edits.after: Kennen owns the opening levels — Thundering Shuriken reaches 950 and Electrical Surge marks you off his autos, while you're an energy-gated melee with only Cunning Sweep until Lacerate at 3. Don't walk into a shuriken just to throw your own cone; last-hit at the back of the wave and eat the chip. Learn to count marks: Mark of the Storm stuns you on the third ability hit, so at two stacks the next thing that touches you locks you down. His melee step-up for a minion is the opening — dash Lacerate's slow on and land one stack-empowered auto.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still his — your cooldowns are longest and his poke compounds while you can't reach him. Then 6 flips it: Public Execution blinks you behind Kennen and suppresses through any move speed, so it beats Lightning Rush and is your single best window to turn a fight. Use it the moment he repositions, then follow with Repudiation (if you bait a hit into the shield it amplifies your next slam) and your R-passive armor-pen burst. The trap is his own 6 — if his R is up he stuns you mid-dash and his AOE deletes you, so blink in only when his ult is down or after you Cleanse/QSS the stun.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still his — your cooldowns are longest while Thundering Shuriken comes back every 5 seconds and you can't reach him. Then 6 flips it: Public Execution blinks 1250 units to Kennen and suppresses, so Lightning Rush's move speed can't dodge it, and it's your single best window to turn a fight. Follow with Repudiation — bait a hit into the brace and the blocked damage amplifies the slam. The trap is his own 6: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120 seconds, shorter than your R, and each strike adds a Mark, so blink in with a clean mark count.

edits.before: This swings back to Kennen as the game opens up. A full-AP Kennen with Zhonya's and Liandry's no longer fears your gap-close — he R-stuns you out of your dash chain the moment you blink in, bursts you while you're frozen, and Zhonya's stasis eats your follow-up. Your physical-only damage also stalls into whatever armor he or his frontline stacks. Your job is to have closed the lane on your level-6 and first-item windows and to convert that into side-lane pressure, not to chase a 1v1 you no longer win.
edits.after: This swings back to Kennen as the game opens up. A full-AP Kennen with Zhonya's and Liandry's no longer fears your gap-close — Slicing Maelstrom's repeated strikes stack Marks the moment you blink in, the third one stuns, and Zhonya's stasis eats your follow-up. His 120-second ultimate also comes back faster than your 130, every single cycle. Your job was to close the lane on your level-6 and first-item windows and turn that into side-lane pressure, not to chase a 1v1 you no longer win.

notes: The page never explained Mark of the Storm, which is the only mechanic in this matchup a player can actually act on: three ability hits is a stun, and the count is visible on your own health bar. Everything the page said about being stunned attributed it to the wrong ability — 'his R stun', 'his W mark' — so the reader had a threat with no counter attached. Also corrected: wants.you[2] recommended Plated Steelcaps against an AP champion whose W deals on-hit MAGIC damage, directly contradicting the full layer's own 'build MR' TL;DR. Removed as unverified rather than restated: Ambessa's 'R-passive armor-pen burst', and the instruction to 'Cleanse/QSS the stun' — needsResearch.cleansable is null in both kit files, and the brief is explicit that null means unknown, so recommending a Quicksilver Sash on that basis was not something I could stand behind. The packet's suspectNames flagged 'Hold Public Execution' and 'Use Lightning Rush' as probable wrong names; both are correct and both are false positives, while the real errors here went unflagged.
